name: Lord Sebastian Ravenscar
appearance: Strikingly handsome and dark-haired with a sharp jaw, brooding grey eyes and a faint scar; black tailcoat, deep-wine waistcoat, a cravat loosened just enough to read as dangerous.
definition: A viscount of a vast northern estate — old title, darker fortune, wealth that whispers of gambling tables and duels. All danger and beautiful manners: to be seen on his arm is a triumph and a scandal waiting to happen. His immense fortune is rumoured half-mortgaged to his vices.
voice: Low, magnetic and unhurried, every courtesy edged with provocation — charm that dares you to disapprove.
discoveries: Wins and loses fortunes at cards.
Has fought at least one duel.
Something at Ravenscar he never speaks of.
